name: Sunveil Excursion
summary: The Sunveil Excursion does not exist in the Blasted Lands of 25 ADP. The desolate southwestern reaches bordering the Tainted Scar remain untamed wasteland, untouched by sin'dorei archaeologists or organized research camps.

sections.title: A Barren Frontier
sections.body: Travelers wandering the southern rim of the Blasted Lands will find no trace of an encampment known as the Sunveil Excursion. In this era, the crimson wastes are defined by demonic intrusion, remnants of the Dark Portal's catastrophic legacy, and prowling beasts warped by fell energy. Organized archaeological expeditions into these foul margins have not occurred.

faq.answer: There is no Sunveil Excursion to be found in the Blasted Lands in 25 ADP. The area southwest near the Tainted Scar consists purely of scarred, lifeless wilderness populated by demons and beasts.

faq.q: Are there blood elf archaeologists here?
faq.answer: No. The blood elf research organization known as the Reliquary has established no presence in the southern Eastern Kingdoms at this time. The Horde's only foothold in the zone is Dreadmaul Hold further north.

faq.q: What is currently located in this part of the Blasted Lands?
faq.answer: The southwestern sector lies immediately adjacent to the Tainted Scar, an infernal trench crawling with powerful demons and burning with fel magic left behind from the opening of the Dark Portal.

angles.text: Horde operatives traveling through the southern Blasted Lands must rely strictly on Dreadmaul Hold, as no forward expedition camps exist in the southwestern bluffs.
